notes: This focused trace covers omission of the declared HLAFOMmoduleIndicator parameter from the standard federation-level HLArequestFOMmoduleData MOM interaction and the resulting standard HLAreportMOMexception payload. The case requires HLAparameterError true for the missing parameter but does not constrain provider-specific synchronous exception types or HLAexception wording, and does not claim complete federation MOM or FOM-module-report conformance.

requirements.statement: The test invokes the standard sendInteraction service with the standard federation MOM interaction class and an empty ParameterHandleValueMap.

HLArequestFOMmoduleData declares HLAFOMmoduleIndicator to identify the FOM module whose data is requested. HLAreportMOMexception shall be sent when a MOM interaction is sent without all necessary parameters; its HLAservice value identifies the interaction class fully qualified, its inherited HLAfederate identifies the joined federate, and HLAparameterError is HLAtrue for an incorrect number of interaction parameters.
